name: pocketpilot
description: PocketPilot: an allowance coach that shows kids what their money adds up to, what it can buy, and how to grow it.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/core && npm run test -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/core && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
